coordinates: Evaluate every accepted environmental T/SP/P record using its own source longitude/latitude in GSW SA conversion and exact sound speed. Include those observed speed extrema alongside nominal-coordinate17^3 rectangle extrema.
path_integral: Report sampled alpha min/max per frequency. Conditional on every local path segment lying inside the accepted physical envelope, bound the two-way absorption integral at physical range r by2*r*alpha_min and2*r*alpha_max. Keep this conditional premise explicit.
range_volume: Combine speed extrema independently for travel-time range and local pulse-volume factor. Compute20log10(c_range/c_nominal)-10log10(c_local/c_nominal)+2*r_nominal*(alpha*c_range/c_nominal-alpha_nominal) for every alpha/speed-bound corner. This is more conservative than a homogeneous point calculation.
gates: Retain1dB at38kHz and2m displacement. Report homogeneous sampled and conditional path-extrema checks separately. Neither is a continuous-envelope proof or QC approval.
no_scope_change: Same source selection, full calendar, units, uncertainty allowances, original analysis band, one fixed training hour and no acoustic test access.
